title: Ricotta, Blueberry and Honey Toasts
excerpt: Enjoy a quick, sophisticated breakfast with these artisan bread toasts, creamy ricotta cheese, honey and the natural freshness of our high-mountain blueberries.
imageAlt: Artisan bread toasts topped with creamy ricotta cheese, whole blueberries and a glossy drizzle of honey.

ingredients.text: 4 slices of artisan bread (sourdough or multigrain)

steps: Toast the artisan bread slices in a skillet over medium heat or in a toaster until they are golden and crunchy.
In a small bowl, mix the ricotta cheese with the lemon zest and a pinch of sea salt until you get a smooth cream.
Spread a generous layer of the ricotta mixture over each slice of hot bread.
Top with the Fresh Pick blueberries. Grown more than 2,800 meters above sea level in Guasca, their natural sweetness contrasts wonderfully with the mild tang of the ricotta.
Finish by drizzling the toasts with pure honey and garnishing with fresh mint leaves right before serving.
tips: Do not wash the Fresh Pick blueberries until the exact moment you assemble the toasts; this keeps their natural bloom intact and their freshness for longer.
If you prefer a warmer texture, warm the blueberries in a skillet with a few drops of honey over low heat for 1 minute before placing them on the ricotta.
